# Stage an exact publication

**Input:** resume `stage-publication`, certified current repo head, grouped-case readiness and existing working PR draft.

**Read:** [full publication rules](../delivery-rules.md#approved-execution-and-handoff), [working PR draft](../working-pr-draft.md), [harness read-back](../harnesses.md#normalizing-a-direct-azure-pr-read-back), and [approval to action](../playbook.md#approval-to-action).

**Skills:** invoke available `azure-pr-write` and its format/evidence guidance for What Happened, Insight and Proof of Works. Reuse prior explanation, review and proof rather than commissioning another panel.

**Action:** reconcile the one PR draft's case claims with actual artifacts and environment boundaries. Stage exact repo, branch/head, title/body, associations and attachment bytes using existing commands. Show the exact proposal/hash for genuine approval. Ticket field/link/comment/attachment changes require their own exact-content approval. Approval of earlier copy does not approve revised copy.

**Output:** staged publication payload and hash, evidence links/attachments and either actual user approval or the exact missing decision.

**Stop/return:** wait only for missing required approval or a concrete grouped publication hold. Existing approved publication bypasses authorship and goes to approved-action. Once approved, resume and execute through native tools with direct remote read-back; a local draft is not a published PR, merge or deployment.
